## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Rù Āpídámó Lùn* 入阿毘達磨論 (Skt. *Abhidharma-avatāra-śāstra* "Introduction to the Abhidharma", CBETA T28n1554) is a Tang dynasty translation of a Sarvāstivāda Abhidharma introductory manual, 2 juan, composed by the arhat Skandhila 塞建陀羅 ([塞建陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A1%9E%E5%BB%BA%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85)) and translated by Xuánzàng 玄奘 ([玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98)). The source text reads "塞建陀羅阿羅漢造，三藏法師玄奘奉詔譯."

**Abstract**

The *Abhidharma-avatāra* ("entry into Abhidharma") is a concise Sarvāstivāda primer attributed to the arhat Skandhila 塞建陀羅 (*Skandhila*, also written 塞建地羅 in DILA). It functions as an introductory text (*avatāra* "entry/descent") to the more elaborate Abhidharma corpus, providing accessible definitions of fundamental categories. A Tibetan translation of the same text also survives in the Tengyur (D4100), attributed to *Skandhila*. The text is placed by modern scholars in approximately the 4th–6th century CE, likely in the Kaśmīra tradition of condensed Abhidharma manuals that parallels the *Hṛdaya* lineage ([KR6l0015](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0015)–[KR6l0017](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6l/KR6l0017)).

Xuánzàng translated this text as part of his systematic rendering of Sarvāstivāda Abhidharma literature during the Táng.
